domain-information: A Customer submits a customization request to outline desired vehicle modifications.
A Customer approves a proposed customization plan to confirm the budget.
A Customization Specialist designs a customization plan consisting of customization tasks.
A Customization Specialist evaluates the customer request to determine feasible modifications.
A Customization Specialist prepares a work order to coordinate tasks with the technicians.
A Technician performs customization tasks on the vehicle to implement the approved design.
A Technician reports missing or depleted parts to avoid delays in the customization process.
A Parts Manager checks inventory levels to verify whether parts required for upcoming jobs are available.
A Parts Manager places an order for parts to support complex customization projects.
A Quality Inspector reviews the completed vehicle to ensure modifications meet safety and design standards.
A Quality Inspector issues a completion approval of the work order so the vehicle can be returned to the customer.

associations.description: Customization Specialist evaluates the Customization Request
Customization Specialist creates the Customization Plan
Customization Specialist issues the Work Order
Work Order assigns tasks to the Technician
Customization Task is applied to the Vehicle
Quality Inspector performs the Modification Review
Quality Inspector issues the Completion Approval
Completion Approval validates the Work Order
Technician submits the Part Depletion Report
Part Depletion Report notifies the Parts Manager
Parts Manager creates the Part Order
